I can’t watch external sites or send proactive messages while you’re offline. I won’t say I’m “on it” because that would be misleading.

I can, instead, do one of these for you before you board — tell me which and confirm any details requested, and I’ll produce the exact steps or script immediately:

Options (pick one)
- A short Python script that polls the vendor portal (API or page) every N minutes and sends an email/SMS/Slack when the SOC2 report appears. Tell me: portal URL, whether there’s an API or requires login/page scraping, polling interval, and preferred notification channel (email/SMS/Slack). Do NOT share credentials here; I’ll show where to put them locally.
- Instructions to enable vendor-portal built-in notifications (if supported). Tell me if the portal has an “alerts” or “notifications” section.
- A Zapier/IFTTT or Power Automate recipe that watches an email inbox or the portal and posts to Slack/email. Tell me which services you use.
- A compact checklist and email/Slack message template you can hand to a colleague to watch it for you.

Which do you want, and what notification method (email/SMS/Slack)? Confirm and I’ll prepare the exact script or steps.
